system.description: A complex computer program that tracks the heroes and directs the security system against them. Like Inhibitor Processes, it directs automated lasers, knockout gas, sonic weapons, electroshock weapons, etc. Use the Seeker Process’s die to direct these actions. (1 — Red severe electronic immunosecurity.)
system.tactics: The Seeker Process wants to reduce the number of threats as quickly as possible, so it prefers to go after weak hero targets it thinks it can take down.

system.description: As a computer program, the seeker process is only susceptible to computer-based technological attacks. Physical attacks against it are ineffective.
